_README: Reviewed, accepted audit findings that should not count as noise. scripts/audit_sdk.py loads this file and, on EVERY run, re-derives findings and only suppresses an entry while its finding still occurs (for enums, only the listed values are suppressed; newly appeared values stay active). Entries that match nothing are reported under 'Stale Ignores' so this list stays honest. Nothing here is hard-coded in the script — to accept a finding, add an entry; to stop accepting it, delete the entry. Match fields: 'type' + 'key' (+ 'direction' for enum_staleness). 'values' (enum only): "*" = all, or a list of specific values. 'reason'/'added' are documentation.
